title: "Could not determine the type for the passed topic" in ros2 topic echo: publisher timing, the daemon, domain ID, custom messages, RMW and discovery range, measured
excerpt: ros2 topic echo exited after about 1 s instead of waiting for a publisher. Passing the type made it wait and receive. Also: a daemon that misses new publishers, unsourced custom messages, Fast DDS vs Cyclone and localhost-only across containers. Measured on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
